titulo: Myths of 'my business doesn't need a website'
hooks: Your industry doesn't need a website?
Word of mouth isn't enough anymore
They got referred. Now they're Googling you
voz: I live off word of mouth. Great, but the first thing a referral does is look you up on their phone. My customers are all local. Locals check photos and hours before they come in too. I don't sell online. They still look you up there to decide whether to reach out.

captions: Word of mouth still works, with one extra step in the middle: before calling you, the person who got referred looks you up on their phone. If they find nothing, they hesitate.
Welder, plumber, accountant, vet: it doesn't matter what you do. These days everyone gets Googled before anyone reaches out.
My customers are all local, I live off word of mouth, I don't sell online. All three have some truth to them, and all three leave you out when someone looks you up on their phone.
Your best customer came from a referral. The next one will look you up on their phone before calling, and depending on what they find, they call or they don't.
